name: sentinel-analytics
description: Component 4 research dashboard for the Sentinel project: trends, forecasts, risk profiles, correlations and recommendations from analytics.json (simulated data until Component 2 is ready).

sentinelAnalytics.dataPath.markdownDescription: Path to `analytics.json` written by the Component 4 pipeline (`python -m src.pipeline`). Absolute, or relative to the first workspace folder, e.g. `component-4-dashboard/ml/outputs/analytics.json`. Leave empty to use the bundled 20-developer sample.

sentinelAnalytics.showStatusBar.description: Show a Sentinel Analytics entry in the status bar.

scripts.build: npm run build:webview && npm run build:extension
